programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid Brazil
programme.desc: Men and women, who meet naked on camera, form pairs and are challenged to survive in one of the most inhospitable environments in the world without food, water or clothes.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

programme.desc: Tom Hanks narrates a 10-episode television event exploring the worlds and wildlife of North and South America, following amazing creatures across frozen mountains, barren deserts and dense jungles in awe-inspiring, never-before-seen footage.

programme.title: Okavango: River of Dreams
programme.desc: An exploration of the wildlife and landscapes of the Okavango River in Southern Africa, embarking on a journey along the river's path.

programme.title: Beach Jackals
programme.desc: Threatened by Southern Africa's farmers, black-backed jackals find new shelter in the restricted and arid area of Namibia's Skeleton Coast. They adapt to a new lifestyle and learn to cooperate to hunt bigger prey, like fur seals.

programme.title: Lion Queens: Fighting For Survival
programme.desc: Every year in Tanzania, the dry season hits the Ruaha reserve hard. To survive, animal populations come down from the high plateaus to reach the Ruaha river, where a troupe of lionesses waits patiently, poised for combat.

programme.title: Wild Cats
programme.desc: From the mighty lions of Africa and the elusive snow leopards of Asia to the pumas of the North American mountains and the jaguars of the Amazon. These stunningly graceful animals are some of the most vicious and territorial on the planet.

programme.title: Animals At Night
programme.desc: Through the vicissitudes, discoveries and encounters of a young boar forgotten by its family, discover the heart of nocturnal life in nature, tracking the adventures and behaviors of animals in the darkness that has hidden them from us until now. A previously unimagined bustling of activity, that the very latest technology is now, paradoxically, bringing into the light of day.

programme.title: Big Beasts: Last of the Giants
programme.desc: Shot across the continents of Australia, Asia, the Americas and Africa, this three-part nature documentary series delves into the Earth's biggest beasts, from five-ton elephant seals to the dignified African lion. Biologist Patrick Aryee embarks on a global mission to explore the biggest beasts and the conservation challenges that face them in an ever-changing world. Full of beautiful natural history photography, illustrated graphics of extinct gigantic beasts and stunning close encounters, this series looks at why size really does matter in the natural world.

programme.title: Wild Kingdoms
programme.desc: An unforgettable expedition across diverse landscapes of Africa exploring the fascinating lives of their extraordinary inhabitants.

programme.title: Japan's Wild Side
programme.desc: We travel from the forests of Hokkaido to the shores of Okinawa to uncover the secrets of Japan's most extraordinary creatures.

programme.title: Texas Gator Savers
programme.desc: From reptiles in swimming pools to gators stranded after hurricanes, Gary Saurage and his team rescue alligators from unusual places and prepare them for life in their new home "Gator Country."

programme.title: Hot Life Africa
programme.desc: The threat of climate change is especially a risk for those living in the world's hottest regions, such as the Namib, the Kalahari and the Kaokoveld in the southern cone of Africa.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas
programme.desc: From turf wars, to food fights, to mating mayhem, nature is all about competition and the quest to be the best. Every day, the planet is a battleground as animals go head-to-head with their own kind.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Located just 10 miles from New York's Times Square, the Bronx Zoo is a recognised world leader in animal care and species conservation. It houses more than 6,000 animals and has a staff of 500-plus people dedicated to their care and well-being. Never before have camera crews been granted full access to the 265-acre campus, until production of the docuseries `The Zoo'. The results are stories focusing on dozens of animals and experiences at the facility, and its critical mission to conserve wildlife around the world. Episodes also highlight various employees and how their expertise and skills help provide top-quality care for the animals.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: Carrying on late wildlife conservationist Steve Irwin's mission to bring people closer to animals is now the mission of his family. Terri, Bindi and Robert Irwin return to Animal Planet, giving viewers access to their wildlife adventures around the world and the amazing animals that continue to inspire their conservation efforts. The series features the family caring for more than 1,200 animals at the Australia Zoo; overseeing a world-class wildlife hospital, the largest of its kind in the world; and conducting high-level global expeditions.

programme.title: Jewels of the Natural World
programme.desc: Explores stunning natural landscapes and how animals act on their protective and fierce nature to survive and reproduce.

programme.title: Into the Wild: India
programme.desc: A journey into India's wilderness highlighting some of its most iconic creatures and diverse habitats. Ranging from tundra to extreme desert, rainforest to urban jungle which provide varied ecological and geographical areas for species to survive.

programme.title: Naked and Afraid
programme.desc: Discovery Channel takes the ubiquitous survival show theme to the next level by stripping it to its bare essentials. In "Naked and Afraid," complete strangers -- usually a man and a woman -- meet in a very unique way: They're stranded in a dangerous, desolate location, without food or water, and they're completely naked. Each episode follows the adventurers as they attempt to survive on their own with nothing but a personal item and the knowledge that the only prize is their pride and sense of accomplishment. Because there is no other choice, competitors quickly get to know one another -- and their surroundings -- and hope that their instincts, survival skills and intestinal fortitude serve them well.

With each dive into the unknown, they encounter creatures and sights that most people will never get to experience.
